traits.desc: Creature that enters space within 10 ft. of sheriff for 1st time on a turn or starts turn there: DC 13 Cha save or be unable to speak deliberate lie until it starts its turn more than 10 ft. away from sheriff. Creatures affected by this are aware of it and sheriff knows whether creature in area succeeded/failed save.
